<security_assessment>

<details>
The PKGBUILD file follows standard Arch User Repository (AUR) packaging practices and shows no signs of malicious behavior. The source is a tagged release archive (v0.3.0), which is properly checksummed with a SHA-256 hash, ensuring integrity.

The build process sets secure Go build flags including CGO_ENABLED=0 (disabling cgo for static builds), -trimpath (removing file system paths from binaries), and -mod=readonly (preventing modification of module dependencies). The ldflags are used to embed version information and strip debug symbols (-s -w), which is common practice. No network requests, file downloads, or system modifications occur during build or package phases beyond what is expected for compiling and installing the software.

All installed files are sourced directly from the extracted tarball: the built binary, README.md, and LICENSE. These are placed in standard system locations with appropriate permissions. There are no obfuscated commands, unexpected file operations, or execution of external scripts. The package appears to be safely maintained and consistent with the stated purpose of providing a command-line tool and web UI for the Throne API.
</details>
